Lena (Sales): Heads-up: Trial customer 'Stonebird' is getting a burst of 429s during a large embeddings ingest. Demo in 2h. acct:STB-504 — needs a fast fix they can rely on.

Omar (SE): Which endpoint and what pattern? Any response headers/body we can paste?

Lena (Sales): /v1/embeddings. Customer logs show lots of single-row requests from 120 concurrent workers. Example response: 
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 150
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1778889750
Body: {"error":"rate_limited", "detail":"per_route_credit_depleted"}

Priyanka (Infra): "per_route_credit_depleted" -> route-level bucket drained by parallel single-item calls. Account-level quota still has headroom. Short-term options: 1) ask client to batch requests, 2) temporary per-route reservation. Which do they prefer?

Lena (Sales): They can't change code before demo. Requesting platform-side patch.

Rex (Oncall): I can add a short-lived reservation. Propose +250 rps on /v1/embeddings for STB-504 for 3 hours to cover demo + buffer. Will flip on extra tracing. Apply now?

quota-bot: Temporary reservation created: +250 rps to route "/v1/embeddings" for acct:STB-504 until 1778893600. Ticket: DBG-11822. :white_check_mark:

Omar (SE): For customer-facing guidance: 1) Use batched embeddings (up to 64 items/call) to reduce QPS. 2) Add exponential backoff on 429s. 3) If you need predictable POC throughput repeatedly, request a preflight reservation 24h in advance.

Lena (Sales): Sent the note. They asked: "Does the reservation change billing or consume quota?"

Priyanka (Infra): Short answer: temporary support reservations for trials are not billed; we track usage for conversion analysis. I'll confirm with finance and add a sentence to the canned reply.

Omar (SE): Quick retry snippet I sent them (python):
```python
import time, random
for attempt in range(5):
    resp = client.embeddings.create(inputs=batch)
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        sleep = (2 ** attempt) * 0.1 + random.random() * 0.05
        time.sleep(sleep)
        continue
    break
```

Priyanka (Infra): Follow-ups for us: 1) add a POC preflight form (expected QPS, batch size, run window) to the SE playbook; 2) add clearer docs on how embeddings expand into request-QPS vs token-budget; 3) consider a small opt-in trial reservation product in the console. Filing RFC.

Rex (Oncall): Import completed at 1778889998, no further 429s observed. I'll keep the reservation active until TTL and then revoke automatically.

Lena (Sales): Demo team confirmed success. I'll keep ticket DBG-11822 open for 24 hours for smoke monitoring. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
